settings.title: Turn-by-turn on the cluster and HUD
settings.description: The switch the Wireless mod 2.x had, kept so owners who had it off keep it off: with it off this mod does nothing (turning the mod off in HMG-API does the same). This mod takes over your turn-by-turn settings from the Wireless mod 2.x once, the first time it starts, if you haven't saved any of its own. Takes effect when the head unit restarts.

settings.title: Turns in the car's own format (AR HUD arrow, distance bar)
settings.description: Near each maneuver (about 1,500 ft), Android Auto's and CarPlay's turns go to the cluster and HUD as the car's own navigation sends them: turn, U-turn, fork, exit and roundabout types with their angle and the distance bar counting down, which the AR HUD animates; destinations as left, right or ahead; with Android Auto, "Recalculating..." during a reroute longer than a second. Off: the projection icons, as before. Checked with Android Auto on a US Ioniq 5 and with CarPlay on a Korean EV6, both with the AR HUD. Takes effect when the head unit restarts.

settings.title: CarPlay: the intersection's side streets around the turn arrow
settings.description: With "Turns in the car's own format" on: near a turn, the cluster draws the roads of the intersection around the arrow, as Korean cars' own navigation does, from the junction the iPhone sends (Apple Maps sends it for many city turns; turns without it keep the plain arrow). Android Auto sends no junction shape. Not yet checked on a car: if the AR HUD stops animating turns with it on, turn it off and report it. Takes effect when the head unit restarts.

settings.title: Car navigation: intersections around the turn arrow (test)
settings.description: The car's own navigation draws each turn's side streets on the cluster, as it does in Korea; outside Korea its engine works them out but sends none. Changes the navigation engine in memory (the file stays stock), only on engine builds the mod knows (so far the US Ioniq 5's on 260507); on others nothing changes and HMG-API's log says so. Not yet checked on a car: if the navigation or the AR HUD misbehaves, turn it off. Takes effect when the head unit restarts.

settings.title: Car navigation: log the intersection ahead (test, for Android Auto's side streets)
settings.description: For developing side streets under Android Auto: once a second the mod reads the car navigation's map at the intersection ahead (its roads, read only) and writes their angles to HMG-API's log when they change; nothing goes to the cluster. Only on navigation engine builds the mod knows (so far the US Ioniq 5's on 260507). It calls into the navigation's engine: if the navigation misbehaves, turn it off and send the log. Takes effect when the head unit restarts.

settings.title: Android Auto: the intersection's side streets from the car's map (test)
settings.description: With "Turns in the car's own format" on: near a turn, the cluster draws the roads of the intersection around Android Auto's arrow, taken from the car navigation's own map, since Android Auto sends no junction shape. Only where the map's junction at the phone's distance matches the turn unambiguously; anywhere else the plain arrow, as before. Only on navigation engine builds the mod knows (so far the US Ioniq 5's on 260507). It calls into the navigation's engine: if the navigation or the AR HUD misbehaves, turn it off and send the log. Takes effect when the head unit restarts.

settings.title: Android Auto: the intersection's side streets from the lanes (test)
settings.description: With "Turns in the car's own format" on: near a turn that comes with lanes, the cluster draws the intersection from Android Auto's lanes: a road for each way they point (left, straight, right, slight, sharp), and the arrow pointing the way the recommended lane goes when Maps' instruction and its lanes disagree. Ahead of the car's map (tbt_map_side_streets), which is used for turns without lanes. Lanes show only the roads a lane may turn into, so a road nobody may enter (a one-way street, a banned left) isn't drawn, and turns without lanes keep the plain arrow unless the map has them. Takes effect when the head unit restarts.
